optional_gate: Initial BPR best mean fold NDCG strictly exceeds baseline by 1e-12; only then one 8-factor run, all other settings unchanged
pair_policy: All strict unequal observed rating pairs, equal pairs omitted, no unseen negatives, no gap weights
objective: sum softplus(-p_u*(q_i-q_j)) + lambda*(sum P^2+sum Q^2); exact global L2 lazy scaling SGD
foldin: Reuse pairwise_mf.fold_in: fixed Q, zero initialized Newton50/backtracking20, L2 .01, tolerance1e-8
normalization: sigmoid((raw - mean known Support raw scores)/T); T=max(RMS of learned TRAIN pair gaps,1e-6); same monotonic scores for all alphas
fallback: No usable pairwise user vector: complete original Hybrid .25. Unknown candidate factor: unchanged Content then popularity fallback
selection: Mean positive-user fold NDCG, then Recall, then Hit Rate; strict improvement over baseline required; ties prefer alpha closer .25 then 4 factors
evaluation: Exact V26 developer50 folds, Support5, candidate479, relevance .7; no reserved25 labels; not independent final evaluation
